title: Epic Hyperdrive & Hyperspace Client Deployment & Lifecycle Management with Microsoft Intune
author_notes: Derived from a Senior Endpoint Engineer (healthcare/Epic) requirement: lead Epic client deployment & lifecycle (Hyperspace/Hyperdrive).

Scope: package, deploy, ring, validate, supersede, and retire the Epic clinical client (Hyperdrive + legacy Hyperspace) via Microsoft Intune Win32 (and ConfigMgr co-management). Epic-internal installer/version values deferred to the customer's Epic Technical Services / UserWeb. White-label.
pricing: T4 (project/migration) — multi-phase packaging + rings + lifecycle across a clinical fleet.
